messages:
maria: Morning — quick triage. Volume steady at ~18 open tickets, 3 high priority (auth 2, embeddings 1). Rolling issue: customers hitting 503s on /v1/embeddings intermittently since 03:40 UTC. Seen in eu-west-1 and hosted. Pinged eng-runtime.
kenji: thx. any common error patterns? stack traces / logs?
maria: logs show transient connection resets between runtime and kvcache. example: "error: upstream read eof". Retry helps. I've escalated to eng-runtime that they may be routing to fallback.
jen: taking the high-priority auth ones. will look at logs now. if anyone has a macro for token-regen steps pls drop.
support-ops-bot: created incident INC-2026-03-17-embeddings-503s, assigned to eng-runtime. https://incident.redwood.com/INC-2026-03-17-embeddings-503s
kenji: ok i'm +1 on kvcache routing suspicion. can we try disabling cross-AZ routing for a canary customer?
maria: would need eng-runtime to flip a flag. @oz can you help coordinate? @kenji will pair on validation.
oz: sure — I'll ask runtime to hold a canary toggle. pinged @eng-runtime in that channel.
jen: macro for token regen (copyable):
```text
Hi — to rotate tokens for a service account:
1) Go to Console > Service Accounts > choose SA
2) Click Rotate key
3) Update env var: REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx
4) Restart worker: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/support-workers`
If you need help, lmk.
``` 
maria: added that macro as "token-rotate-v2" and updated internal macro set.
support-ops-bot: macro "token-rotate-v2" saved by maria.
alexa: quick FYI — queue has 2 stuck webhook retries on T-3391, hitting external provider 429. I've temp-snoozed them.
kenji: thx. jen, can you triage auth tickets and tag which need eng help vs. customer-side action?
jen: on it. will post ticket IDs in ~15.
maria: action items: (1) eng-runtime investigate kvcache cross-AZ routing (kenji + oz), (2) support to apply token-rotate macro on 2 auth tickets (jen), (3) monitor embeddings 503 alert for next 2 hours (maria). Any blockers?
kenji: no blockers from my side. scheduling a 15-min sync in 20 to coordinate the canary.
jen: none. will update once I triage.
maria: thanks — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
